title: EAM Book 1 · Unit 2 · Part 2 · Grammar Review

text.en: Welcome to Auto Maintenance, Book 1. This is Unit 2, Under the Bonnet.
text.ar: أهلاً بكم في صيانة السيارات، الكتاب الأوّل. هذه الوحدة الثانية، تحت غطاء المحرّك.

text.en: This is Part 2, Grammar Review. You will find the mistake, then choose the correct sentence.
text.ar: هذا الجزء الثاني، مراجعة القواعد. ستجد الخطأ، ثمّ تختار الجملة الصحيحة.

text.en: Each sentence has one mistake. Find it, then say the correct sentence.
text.ar: في كلّ جملة خطأ واحد. اعثر عليه، ثمّ قل الجملة الصحيحة.

text.en: There is two batteries in the store.
text.ar: صحّح هذه الجملة: There is two batteries in the store.

text.en: There are two batteries in the store. Two batteries are plural.
text.ar: There are two batteries in the store. بطاريتان جمع.

text.en: How much filters are there?
text.ar: صحّح هذه الجملة: How much filters are there?

text.en: How many filters are there? Filters are countable.
text.ar: How many filters are there? الفلاتر معدودة.

text.en: There are much oil in the engine.
text.ar: صحّح هذه الجملة: There are much oil in the engine.

text.en: There is much oil in the engine. Oil is uncountable.
text.ar: There is much oil in the engine. الزيت غير معدود.

text.en: Is there some brake fluid?
text.ar: صحّح هذه الجملة: Is there some brake fluid?

text.en: Is there any brake fluid? It is a question, so any.
text.ar: Is there any brake fluid? إنّه سؤال، فنستخدم any.

text.en: Now choose the correct sentence.
text.ar: الآن اختر الجملة الصحيحة.

text.en: There are three filters, or there is three filters?
text.ar: There are three filters، أم there is three filters؟

text.en: There are three filters.
text.ar: There are three filters. هذه هي الصحيحة.

text.en: There are many hoses, or there is many hoses?
text.ar: There are many hoses، أم there is many hoses؟

text.en: There are many hoses.
text.ar: There are many hoses. هذه هي الصحيحة.

text.en: Now, write two sentences about your own workshop.
text.ar: الآن، اكتب جملتين عن ورشتك.

text.en: One with there is, and one with there are.
text.ar: واحدة مع there is، وواحدة مع there are.

text.en: Pause the video, and write them now.
text.ar: أوقف الفيديو، واكتبهما الآن.

text.en: Here is an example. There is some oil on the bench. There are three filters in the box.
text.ar: هذا مثال. هناك بعض الزيت على الطاولة. هناك ثلاثة فلاتر في الصندوق.

text.en: You will see these again in the Part 5 reading. Watch for them.
text.ar: ستراها مرّة أخرى في قراءة الجزء الخامس. راقبها.
